title: fluxqc: Detection limits and quality screens for chamber flux measurements, on top of goFlux
description: An R package extending goFlux (Rheault et al. 2024) for chamber flux measurements on any surface (soil, water, stems, leaves): empirical analyzer precision (MAD of first differences per constant-interval run, Allan deviation), minimum detectable flux by several published methods with detection flags (retain-and-flag), toggleable physical quality screens that only append columns, multi-gas window selection, non-interactive window detection, a one-call pipeline with explicit outputs, import helpers for very large LI-7810 files and a clock-offset utility.
